intro:
Use it for a setting that takes effect as soon as it changes: notifications on, dark mode off. There is nothing to save afterwards.

For a choice that only applies when a form is sent, such as agreeing to terms, use a checkbox. For a choice between more than two options, use [Tabs](/docs/web/components/tabs) or a radio group.

Give every switch a name. Wrap it in a [Label](/docs/web/components/label), tie a label to its `id`, or pass `label` when the name is shown elsewhere on the screen.
usage:
<Switch label="Dark mode" defaultChecked />

<Label>
  <Label.Text>Email me a receipt</Label.Text>
  <Label.Action>
    <Switch />
  </Label.Action>
</Label>

examples.title: With a label
examples.description: Inside a `Label`, the whole line turns the switch on and off. `Label.Action` sets the switch at the end of the line. A disabled switch fades its label with it, with nothing passed.

examples.title: Sizes
examples.description: `xs`, `sm`, `md`, `lg` and `xl`. The thumb stays a circle at every size, and the track is the room it travels.

examples.title: Colours
examples.description: `color` sets what it fills with when on. Keep `primary` for most switches. Use `success`, `info` or `destructive` where the setting's meaning calls for it, such as a switch that deletes things.

examples.title: Saving a change
examples.description: `pending` turns a ring in the thumb and stops the switch being pressed again. Show the new state at once, set `pending` while the change is saved, and put the old state back if it fails. Here the second change of each setting fails.

notes:
### Motion

The colour sweeps along the track behind the thumb rather than fading in. While the switch is pressed, the thumb stretches towards where it will go. With reduced motion turned on, it switches in place.

### Keyboard

The switch is a button with `role="switch"`. Space and Enter flip it.

### In a form

Pass `name` and the switch submits with the form, as a checkbox does. `required` makes it one that must be on.

### Built on

It is the Base UI switch, which the package depends on directly.
